_: What the assistant reads before it scans, judges or applies for jobs. Copy to profile.json and edit; profile.json is in .gitignore.

quality.scale: 1-5: 1 generic ad, 3 real team and stack named, 5 stack matches skills and seniority fits
weak: 3+ years asked at a junior title

cv.style: plain, first person, short sentences, a number or link under every claim
avoid: claims without a link or number

cover_letter.tone: direct, specific to the posting, no flattery

apply_only_if: score >= quality.min_score and no deal_breaker matches; otherwise add it to applications.json as stage 'watching' with a one-line reason
